en.title: Zine! Zine! Zine! — Ideas in Motion
en.html:
Transcript

00:00:06 Zine! Zine! Zine! — Ideas in Motion

00:00:21 Ideas in Motion is an exhibition supervised by Xiao Jian.

00:00:25 Students on the History of Communication Thought course

00:00:27 present works on themes including

00:00:29 individual memories,

00:00:31 our most intimate media,

00:00:33 the communication ideas we most want to follow or challenge,

00:00:36 and the future media forms we most want to realise.

00:00:39 Together, they offer a feast of ideas.

00:00:43 Liu Songting, course student: It mainly has two parts.

00:00:45 One is a physical metaphor of myself.

00:00:47 The other consists of

00:00:49 some works derived from it.

00:00:52 That media montage

00:00:53 is my later expression of

00:00:55 some of my attitudes towards life.

00:00:59 Zhao Xinran, course student: Before the exhibition,

00:01:00 Xiao Jian said she wanted

00:01:02 to buy some toilets to use as seats.

00:01:04 That may have inspired me

00:01:06 to make something related to toilets.

00:01:10 Another aspect is that

00:01:11 I have told friends

00:01:13 that I now find it difficult to read

00:01:16 long texts… to do long-form reading.

00:01:20 My reading time now consists of

00:01:22 very fragmented activities.

00:01:23 So I wanted to respond to this…

00:01:26 Huang Ruizhe, course student: I feel a pocket is like

00:01:27 a fixed accessory to a piece of clothing.

00:01:29 If you pull hard, it comes off.

00:01:31 The theme of our exhibition is

00:01:33 Ideas in Motion.

00:01:35 I wanted this fixed pocket

00:01:36 to move as well.

00:01:37 So I wanted the pocket

00:01:39 to carry individual, independent stories,

00:01:41 and to use ribbons

00:01:43 to connect these stories.

00:01:45 That is where my work came from.

00:01:47 An on-site report by the Zhejiang University Integrated Media Centre student reporters.
en.contribution: Reporter, as identified in the supplied film.

zh.title: Zine! Zine! Zine!——流动的思想
zh.html:
字幕全文

00:00:06 Zine! Zine! Zine! 流动的思想

00:00:21 流动的思想是由肖剑老师指导的展览

00:00:25 传播思想史课程的学生

00:00:27 带来的作品主题包括

00:00:29 以个体回忆为内容的

00:00:31 最亲密的媒介

00:00:33 最想追随或是挑战的传播思想

00:00:36 最想实现的未来媒介形式

00:00:39 为我们带来一场思想的盛宴

00:00:43 柳松婷（传播思想史课程学生）：主要分为两个

00:00:45 一个是我的实体的隐喻

00:00:47 还有另外一个是

00:00:49 衍生的一些作品

00:00:52 那个媒介蒙太奇

00:00:53 就是我后来关于

00:00:55 人生态度的一些表达

00:00:59 赵馨然（传播思想史课程学生）：当时在展前

00:01:00 肖剑老师就说她要

00:01:02 买一些马桶作为座椅

00:01:04 这个可能激起了我

00:01:06 想要做厕所这个方面的灵感

00:01:10 还有一个方面就是

00:01:11 我有和朋友说过

00:01:13 我现在已经很难再阅读

00:01:16 长文本的一些……长文本的阅读了

00:01:20 我现在的阅读时间是一些

00:01:22 非常碎片化的行为

00:01:23 所以说我就是想对此

00:01:26 黄睿哲（传播思想史课程学生）：我觉得口袋它就像是

00:01:27 衣服的一个固定的附属品

00:01:29 你一用力它就会扯下来

00:01:31 那么我们这次的主题叫做

00:01:33 流动的思想

00:01:35 我想让这个固定的口袋

00:01:36 也流动起来

00:01:37 所以我想让口袋里面

00:01:39 去承载一个个独立的故事

00:01:41 并且用飘带把这一个个故事

00:01:43 给它连接起来

00:01:45 这就是我作品的来源

00:01:47 浙江大学融媒体中心学生记者团现场报道
zh.contribution: 记者（原片中明确标示的个人角色）。
